After filtering, we obtain 1,072 validated repositories (as of December 12, 2024) and 9,314 executable test files.
We execute each test file using pytest inside a Docker environment and apply Python's built-in trace module to record all triggered functions in source code.
We define test split Easy tasks as those with call-tree depth 1-2, and Hard tasks as those with depth ≥ 3, which typically require implementing 5+ interdependent functions.

We construct the feature description in PRD by using GPT-4o to synthesize a high-level module description from the test file and augmenting the masked function's docstring with implementation-level details.
The training split contains 1,033 repositories, while the test split contains 39 repositories, with no repository overlap between splits.
